about: Every sound effect in the game. The single source of truth: game/src/sfx.cpp emits the game's sounds by these ids, game/web/sfx.js plays them, tools/sfx/synth/render.py renders a placeholder for each and docs/SOUND_EFFECTS.md is generated from this file (python3 tools/sfx/script.py). Drop a recording at any listed path (tools/sfx/convert.sh) to replace the rendered one.

sounds.title: Bowstring release
sounds.when: An archer looses an arrow (a volley: one louder twang).
sounds.record: A recurve or longbow released without an arrow in a quiet room (dry fire can break a bow: use a blank arrow into a bale). Close mic, 30 cm.

sounds.title: Arrow passing
sounds.when: An arrow flies close past the listener while the camera is low; pitched by its closing speed (doppler).
sounds.behaviour: one-shot, positional, pitch swept by the page
sounds.record: Whip a thin dowel or an arrow past the mic, or swing a fishing rod tip; trim to the pass.

sounds.title: Sword swing
sounds.when: A cut or thrust is struck (just before it lands).
sounds.record: Swing a wooden sword or a thin stick fast past the mic; several speeds.

sounds.title: Heavy swing
sounds.when: A club, axe or great beast's swipe.
sounds.record: Swing a broom handle or a towel hard past the mic; low and slow.

sounds.title: Blade into flesh
sounds.when: A cut or chop lands on an unarmoured body: wet tearing slash.
sounds.record: Knife into a cabbage or a raw chicken, wet celery snapped and twisted; layer with a short wet squelch.

sounds.title: Blade on armour
sounds.when: A blow lands on mail or plate: bright metallic clash.
sounds.record: Strike a steel pan lid, a shovel or a tool with a metal bar; hold it loosely so it rings.

sounds.title: Blunt crush
sounds.when: A club, hoof or staff lands: heavy concussive crush.
sounds.record: A rubber mallet into a pumpkin or a wet phone book; a thump on a sandbag.

sounds.title: Point into flesh
sounds.when: A pike, lance, fang or horn goes in.
sounds.record: Stab a melon or a cabbage with a screwdriver; a short wet push.

sounds.title: Blow on a shield
sounds.when: A blow is taken on a wooden shield: a solid wooden thud.
sounds.record: Hit a thick plank or a wooden chopping board with a stick.

sounds.title: Blow on bone
sounds.when: A blow or arrow strikes the walking dead: dry bone crack and rattle.
sounds.record: Snap dry twigs or a chicken bone, rattle a bag of sticks.

sounds.title: Satchel thrown
sounds.when: A dwarf grenadier lobs a satchel charge (the grunt is the dwarf's voice).
sounds.record: A cloth bag of gravel and a half-full bottle swung and tossed onto grass.

sounds.title: Fuse hissing
sounds.when: A satchel's lit fuse fizzing as it flies and rolls.
sounds.record: A sparkler or a match head hissing, close mic (outdoors, safely).

sounds.title: Fireball cast
sounds.when: A wizard gathers fire and hurls it: crackle building to a whoosh.
sounds.record: A torch whooshed past the mic, a gas burner lit; layer with crackling paper.

sounds.title: Catapult release
sounds.when: A catapult's arm slams into its crossbar: creak and thunk.
sounds.record: A heavy door slammed into its frame, a log dropped on a beam; creak a wooden chair first.

sounds.title: Thrown spear (future)
sounds.when: For a future javelin unit (Myth's Soulless): a metallic scream into an air-rending whistle.
sounds.record: A metal rod scraped then whipped past the mic.

sounds.title: Lightning bolt (future)
sounds.when: For a future storm caster (Myth's Fetch): an electric crackle building, then a huge snap.
sounds.record: A cracking whip close up layered with crackling foil and a big thunder clap.

sounds.title: Arrow into the ground
sounds.when: An arrow strikes earth or grass: a dull dead thud.
sounds.record: Push a stick sharply into soft earth or a bale of straw.

sounds.title: Arrow into wood
sounds.when: An arrow sticks in a tree, a door or a beam.
sounds.record: Throw a dart into a plank; a knife into a log.

sounds.title: Arrow off stone
sounds.when: An arrow glances off a wall, rock or merlon.
sounds.record: Flick a nail or a pencil against a stone step; a short tick and skitter.

sounds.title: Arrow into a shield
sounds.when: A shield catches an arrow: a splintering wooden crack.
sounds.record: Snap a thin batten, or hit a plywood sheet with a dart.

sounds.title: Arrow off armour
sounds.when: An arrow strikes mail or plate: a metallic ring.
sounds.record: Flick a nail at a steel pan or a shovel blade.

sounds.title: Arrow into flesh
sounds.when: An arrow hits a man: a wet thwack.
sounds.record: Slap a wet towel; a dart into a raw steak.

sounds.title: Arrow into water
sounds.when: An arrow falls in a river or lake.
sounds.record: Drop a pencil into a bath from a height.

sounds.title: Stone lands
sounds.when: A catapult stone smashes down: crash, crunch and scattering grit.
sounds.record: Drop a paving slab onto gravel; a rock onto a pile of stones.

sounds.title: Gate struck
sounds.when: A blow or blast hits a castle gate: a deep wooden boom.
sounds.record: A sledgehammer on a thick wooden door; record from inside the room too.

sounds.title: Gate breaks
sounds.when: A gate gives way: splintering timbers and a crash.
sounds.record: Break a pallet or old crates with a sledgehammer; layer a heavy fall.

sounds.title: Satchel charge
sounds.when: A satchel charge explodes: huge sub-bass blast with a long tail.
sounds.record: Not recordable at home: use a CC0 explosion library, or a balloon burst close up pitched down an octave and layered with a sub sine drop.

sounds.title: Fireball bursts
sounds.when: A fireball (or a dwarf's cocktail) lands: glass shatter crossfaded into a roaring, crackling fire whoosh.
sounds.record: A bottle broken in a bin (wear goggles) layered with a gas burner whoosh and crackling kindling.

sounds.title: Dismember snap
sounds.when: A cut takes off a limb or head: a sharp organic crunch, a tendon snapping.
sounds.record: Snap a stick of celery or a carrot wrapped in a wet cloth; twist a raw chicken wing apart.

sounds.title: Gib burst
sounds.when: A body is torn apart (a blast, or a blow far past death): a saturated, wet, low organic burst.
sounds.record: Drop a water-soaked sponge or a wet bag of jelly onto concrete; layer a stomped melon.

sounds.title: Blood rain
sounds.when: After a gib burst: drops and bits pattering down all round.
sounds.record: Flick water from a brush onto paper and leaves; drop wet pasta onto a board.

sounds.title: Body falls
sounds.when: A body hits the ground (after the death cry).
sounds.record: Drop a sack of potatoes or a duffel bag of clothes onto earth.

sounds.title: Armoured body falls
sounds.when: A man in armour (or a great beast) hits the ground: thud and clatter.
sounds.record: Drop a duffel bag with a few pans and chains in it.

sounds.title: Bones collapse
sounds.when: One of the walking dead falls apart: a dry clattering heap.
sounds.record: Drop a bundle of dry sticks and a few wooden spoons onto a floor.

sounds.title: Burning body
sounds.when: A body killed by fire: sizzle and crackle as it burns.
sounds.record: Bacon in a hot pan, close; crackling twigs on a fire.

sounds.title: Healing
sounds.when: A journeyman mends a wounded friend: a soft rising shimmer.
sounds.record: Rub a wet finger round a wine glass; brush wind chimes gently.

sounds.title: Victory
sounds.when: The battle is won: a short brass fanfare.
sounds.record: A brass player, or CC0: a short major fanfare, 3-4 s.

sounds.title: Defeat
sounds.when: The battle is lost: a low minor-chord string drone with sub-bass.
sounds.record: Cello or synth strings holding a low minor chord, 5-6 s, fading.

sounds.title: Button
sounds.when: Any button tapped.
sounds.record: A pen click or a wooden bead tapped on a table.

sounds.title: Page turn
sounds.when: A panel opens (settings, news, a town, a briefing).
sounds.record: Turn a stiff page of an old book, close mic.

sounds.title: Mountain wind
sounds.when: Over high passes and peaks (the continent's mountain value under the view): a hollow high howl.
sounds.record: Wind across a bottle mouth; a real gale through a gap (wind shield on the mic).

sounds.title: Valley wind
sounds.when: Over the lowlands: broad low gusts with grit; louder as the camera rises.
sounds.record: Wind in grass and trees on an open field, no traffic.

sounds.title: Swamp insects
sounds.when: Near marsh and mud: cicadas and crickets, panned towards the wet ground.
sounds.record: A summer marsh at dusk, or CC0 insect field recordings.

sounds.title: Frog
sounds.when: Now and then out in the marsh: a single croak at a random point.
sounds.record: Any frog recording; or a balloon squeaked and a comb strummed.

sounds.title: Carrion flies
sounds.when: Over the dead (12 s after they fall), louder the more bodies lie near the view.
sounds.record: Flies over rotting fruit in a bin, close mic.

sounds.title: War drums
sounds.when: Distant, muffled: the enemy approaching (beyond bowshot), or held land (a siege).
sounds.record: Floor toms or a big drum in a large room, recorded from the next room.

sounds.title: Light rain
sounds.when: Weather hook: light rain, a soft patter.
sounds.record: Rain on leaves and a tent.

sounds.title: Heavy rain
sounds.when: Weather hook: a downpour, roaring white noise (damps open fuses).
sounds.record: A heavy shower on a roof, mic indoors by an open window.

sounds.title: Thunder
sounds.when: Weather hook: a low rolling rumble 3-8 s after a lightning flash.
sounds.record: A sheet of thin metal shaken, pitched down; or CC0 thunder.

sounds.title: Cave drips (future)
sounds.when: For future cave maps: water drops with a long reverb.
sounds.record: Drops from a tap into a bucket in a tiled bathroom.

sounds.title: Deep rumble (future)
sounds.when: For future cave or quake moments: a sub-bass rumble.
sounds.record: A car engine idling heard through a wall, pitched down.
